disposition_reason: The broad regional representation registration includes genuine original decoding endpoints. However, the reviewed paper/code do not establish the exact original regional score vector and complete cohort/scoring manifest needed for a paper comparison. The local single-cell significance/fraction evaluator cannot substitute for source population decoding. A new cross-mouse split or pooled scalar would be an extension.

source_paper.title: A brain-wide map of neural activity during complex behaviour

evidence.locator: Methods: Neural analyses; Inclusion criteria; Overview of decoding; Decoding target variables; Decoding cross-validation; Decoding significance testing with null distributions
evidence.supports: Original regional decoding uses balanced accuracy for stimulus/choice/feedback and R-squared for wheel variables, with repeated nested within-session cross-validation and null-corrected regional effects.
The 2023_12_bwm_release fixture, unit-version check and unit/session/region QC define the source loading route; a complete published scoring roster still needs reconciliation.

evidence.locator: TARGET, align_time, time_window, n_runs, estimator_kwargs and trial-mask settings
evidence.supports: Stimulus-side decoding uses nonzero contrast and 0-100 ms stimulus-aligned input; pinned logistic maximum iterations differs from the manuscript.

evidence.locator: run-specific random seeds; shuffled KFold; balanced_accuracy_score/r2_score; concatenated prediction scoring
evidence.supports: Author code supplies deterministic run seeds and nested scoring machinery, but no rerun result is established by this inspection.
Real/null scores are averaged over runs; predictions can be rescored; summary effects retain session and regional identities.

evidence.locator: Full-cohort decoding and summary-table generation workflow
evidence.supports: The source provides a complete-cohort execution route. Debugging subsets are not equivalent to the paper cohort.

target.description: Decode source stimulus side, choice, feedback and wheel variables by brain region; keep endpoint identities separate and preserve the complete registered regional representation scope.

dataset.description: IBL 2023_12_bwm_release with source sorted-spike/trial loaders and unit-version verification.

cohort.description: The paper reports 139 mice, 459 sessions/699 insertions, and 201 analyzed regions/62,857 neurons. The exact endpoint-specific session/unit/region manifest and paper eligibility parity are not frozen here.

split.description: Nested fivefold random interleaved trial CV within each session; ten repetitions for binary targets and two for wheel targets. Retain original fold/seed rules; mouse-held-out evaluation would change the task.

inputs.description: Source-QC neural population spikes per session/region and declared event windows; behavioral targets are labels, not additional decoder features.

preprocessing.description: Source windows and QC are documented, but manuscript logistic max_iter=20000 versus pinned stimulus config max_iter=1000 and downstream region/unit eligibility require reconciliation before baseline replay.

metric.description: Binary balanced accuracy is the mean of class recalls; continuous wheel R-squared is 1-SSE/SST. Use each original target metric and source null correction without replacing them with significance or fraction-responsive scores.

aggregation.description: Score concatenated outer-test predictions per run, average runs per session, then report regional median of session score minus its null median. Significance combines session evidence separately.

comparison.primary_metric: Original per-target regional decoding effect vector: balanced accuracy or R-squared, with source session-null correction

published_baseline.description: Exact numeric values for the original endpoint-by-region comparison vector were not recovered. Figure descriptions and significance counts are not numeric performance baselines.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Pinned decoder and output-processing route exists but has not been replayed or reconciled to manuscript settings and full source coverage.

minimum_effect.rationale: An interpretable task-specific gain for each original metric and a rule across the full endpoint/region family must be declared after baseline recovery; no universal margin is assumed.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare a paired candidate-versus-author analysis preserving source folds and all sessions from each mouse, with appropriate multiple-endpoint treatment; no valid superiority rule has been frozen.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Mouse for biological uncertainty; repeated folds, sessions and units within mouse are not independent replicates.
uncertainty.rationale: The paper null-significance analysis asks whether information is present, not whether a candidate improves the author decoder.

paper_win_requires: Recover and pin the original numerical per-target/per-region baseline, masks, folds and coverage before admitting an improvement episode.
Replay the source decoder on its original within-session task and distinguish that rerun score from the published values.

Candidate and author comparator must share inputs, preprocessing, split, metric, aggregation and declared budgets; no dropped regions, easier target subsets or newly pooled score can establish paper superiority.
Freeze the candidate before final comparison and satisfy a justified meaningful-effect and uncertainty rule. More significant regions or smaller p-values alone do not qualify.
Treat new mouse-held-out splits and the local single-cell evaluator as separately labelled extensions/calibration, never as original-decoder wins.

current_sota.description: No separate current-SOTA source comparison is established.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked pending baseline/source reconciliation. Once admitted, iterate only on the declared source training and validation folds with fixed full regional coverage.
episode.candidate_freeze: Before final outer-test replay, freeze method, feature windows, hyperparameters, source revision, fold manifest and access/resource ledger.
episode.final_evaluation: One protected comparison under the exact original nested-CV scoring contract after competent author replay; public historical targets are not newly blind.
episode.baseline_policy: Published regional scores, reproduced author decoder scores and candidate scores remain distinct. Initial-evaluator-v1 single-cell sensitivity is calibration only.

blocking_issues: Original numerical per-target regional effect vector is not recovered.
Complete source cohort, endpoint-specific masks and region coverage remain unfrozen.
Manuscript versus pinned logistic configuration and unit/region filtering require adjudication.
No qualified author replay, working protected decoder evaluator, meaningful effect rule, paired uncertainty contract or concrete episode budgets is established.

legacy.notes: Preserve initial-evaluator-v1 sorted-spike single-cell sensitivity and regional fractions. Its choice-window/profile discrepancy and prospective mouse-weighted summary cannot establish decoder superiority.
